HistoryCheckpoint.description:
Bounded bridge between the hot snapshot and externally archived compact history.

Ordinary restore compares these totals and rolling head with an atomically
updated archive manifest in work independent of archive size. Explicit
integrity diagnostics stream-verify the external append-only rows and commit
chain without rehydrating them into the hot domain snapshot.

archive_commit_count.description: Number of non-empty atomic commits in the external archive chain.

archive_head_sha256.description: SHA-256 rolling head of the external archive commit chain.

archived_audit_event_count.description: Audit rows externalized from the hot snapshot.

archived_delivery_count.description: Compact delivery rows externalized from the hot snapshot.

archived_request_count.description: Terminal request rows externalized from the hot snapshot.

archived_run_count.description: Terminal run rows externalized from the hot snapshot.

audit_event_count.description: Total audit events accepted over the workspace lifetime, hot and archived.

audit_head_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the canonical serialized final audit event, when any exists.
